authority_chain.behavior: ObjectiveStart calls configured ObjectiveRuntimeHost::submit after original spawn/Fleet generation checks. The separate raw RunStart lifecycle arm is not the signed Circuit execution ingress and does not replace it.

Require current Objective readiness; enforce original five-minute request bound; load current owner-controlled AuthBus trust; authenticate the full serialized original objective body; decode original structured source; preserve original Notes/Desktop source validation and selected profile context.

Under original ObjectiveHostState mutex, require replay admission, invoke original compile_and_publish_objective_run_v1 with exact profile/source/context/authentication/generation/fence/journal head, reload/clone the durable record, advance the exact highest-sequence map. Drop this guard before trust revalidation and selected owner execution.

For Compiled records, call original execute_circuit_task_record first when configured. Preserve actual sealed receipt outcome classification. ExplicitAbstain and original other profiles remain separate.

Original readiness refresh, current runtime generation and domain-separated fence comparison, then current AuthBus trust reload. Reconstruct original SignedMessage claims from retained record authentication and original Agent identity, preserving issuer/key epoch/message/scope/body digest/sequence/expiry/signature. Authenticate original issuer, objective scope, retained signed body digest and current time.

Preserve before-submit, CommitUncertain readback-before, before/after result publication and final current checks. CommitUncertain invokes readback only, never recomputation. No unresolved/missing outcome can become successful receipt; completion outbox only accepts explicitly registered original source run IDs.

rules: Direct child of canonical Agent home

trust_input.signature: authbus signed.rs::SignedMessage::authenticate checks actual issuer/key epoch, Ed25519 verify_strict over all claims, then original structural/revocation/scope/expiry checks. Its temporary ReplayWindow is explicitly not durable replay protection; the original objective journal supplies that.

lock_scopes.order: refresh_generation first; then a short runtime lock checks Running, actual AppServer or finite Notes readiness, critical stores, revocation baseline, required ports, admission_open and not fenced.

Original FleetRegistry.load_agent completes before runtime lock. Preserve layout/resources and Starting/Running/Draining generation relation. On transitions the existing code may take events and then runs while runtime is held; runtime is explicitly dropped before close_neuron_generation_admission. This is a local call-path observation, not a universal lock-order proof.
Temporary runtime mutex access to copy current_generation ends before AuthBus trust-file I/O. There is no lock spanning the full Fleet/trust revalidation.

Runtime admission lock covers Running/open/fence/generation checks and admitted counter increment. It ends before provider.build and handle.submit/readback awaits. Pending/admission guards cover execution and result publication; the worker pending guard survives a cancelled caller as described by original code.
ObjectiveHostState journal/replay mutex is released before P::execute await. Original durable append/ACK failure is not converted to NotApplied.
Both require_current_run_start calls complete before acquiring runs mutex for original start_revalidated_run_start. The run mutex is not held through owner execution.

required_e2_boundaries: Do not expose AgentdState or treat require_current_run_start as a public arbitrary-record grant service. Its retained body digest authentication depends on the original journal/compiler record provenance; it does not reconstruct and independently authenticate every record field from an arbitrary transport DTO.

Retain original owner-controlled AuthBus trust, replay checkpoint and objective profile in the daemon. config_circuit_task.rs::take_circuit_task_bootstrap expressly requires all three and one compatible complete execution profile.

Original circuit_q24_task_channel_v1 already accepts identity/profile without AgentdConfig, constructs the actual Source and same published task Cell, and returns process-local runtime. Its install method later consumes daemon Config. That code separation alone does not transfer Arc/mpsc or same-Arc retirement across processes.
Existing Root production handoff has fixed exact marker, two ordered rights, actual UID0 creator, pidfd/SO_PEERCRED/lifetime checks. It is not an arbitrary transport for a new Cell/RunStart purpose.

Any new process boundary must retain signed ObjectiveStart admission and current revalidation before/after actual work, original uncertainty/readback semantics, complete durable record provenance, same original task/Cell/Source ownership and actual drain. No new grantor/callback or synthetic completed receipt follows from this review.
